title: How does a member get refunded for unused class-credit pack credits?
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. It states the entry point for recording a refund of a pack's unused credits, once that refund is eligible, and how the member's own confirmation of the refund is carried out.

## Applicable situation
A refund of unused credits is recorded once eligible. A pack satisfies this refund's own status eligibility not only through the member's own confirmed cancellation to closed, but equally through administrative archival of an exhausted or expired pack to closed; both routes produce the identical closed status this refund's eligibility accepts.

## How it is invoked
This tool must first be unlocked and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves: record_class_pack_refund_ca79a7d9. It is the member's own decision, carried out only through the member's own confirmation.

## Parameters
- class_pass_id: the reference number of the class-credit pack being refunded.
- refund_amount_usd: the dollar amount being refunded to the member, in USD, rounded to exactly two decimal places, always zero or a positive amount.
- credits_removed: the whole number of class credits being removed from the pack's reconciled balance as part of this refund, a non-negative integer count where each unit represents one class credit.

## Return
On success, record_class_pack_refund_ca79a7d9 returns a confirmation naming the new booking-history entry, echoing the class_pass_id refunded, and stating the credits_delta (the negative of credits_removed) and the amount_usd paid out. No error or review behavior beyond this confirmation is defined for this tool.
